name: personal-health-data-mcp
description: Unofficial community plugin, not affiliated with or endorsed by Withings. Compatible with Withings: read-only MCP tools for your own Withings data (weight and body composition, blood pressure, daily activity, sleep, devices) through the Withings Public API, using your own Withings developer app. Runs locally; sends nothing to the author. General wellness information, not medical advice. Register callback http://localhost:8765/callback (the default) or set WITHINGS_REDIRECT_URI to the exact Callback URL in your app.

WITHINGS_CLIENT_ID.title: Withings app client id
WITHINGS_CLIENT_ID.description: The Client ID of your own Withings developer app (https://developer.withings.com/dashboard/).

WITHINGS_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Withings app client secret
WITHINGS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The Secret of the same app. Stored by Cursor and sent only to Withings when tokens are issued or refreshed. Other MCP clients: set it via WITHINGS_ENV_FILE (see README).

WITHINGS_REDIRECT_URI.title: Callback URL (optional)
WITHINGS_REDIRECT_URI.description: Optional. Must exactly match a Callback URL registered in your Withings developer app. Leave empty to use http://localhost:8765/callback, and register that exact URL. Changing this environment variable requires reloading the window so the server process restarts. Never paste the secret into chat.
